analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of https://ably.com/docs covered 693 pages across 2,071 discovered URLs with 100% crawl coverage. 8 confirmed broken internal links were found, all within user-facing documentation (0 repository links). 739 links could not be verified due to authentication or rate-limiting, representing a significant blind spot. API reference coverage stands at 52.49% across 71 detected API pages, and SEO/geo issues affect 44.3% of pages. Example code reliability is estimated at 87.33%, with 83.12% of pages showing last-updated metadata.

Zero broken repository navigation links; all 8 broken links are user-facing and fixable

Strong last-updated metadata coverage at 83.12% of pages
71 API pages successfully detected with no detection failures flagged
